audit_scope.primary_user: product owner/operator creating a product through the factory
audit_scope.thesis: The best factory UX is autonomous, conversational and evidence-rich: it hides internal bureaucracy, reports meaningful progress, and asks humans only for real decisions with readable packages.

operator_channels.role: current primary operator path for intake, progress, human gates and delivery
operator_channels.upgrade_needed: Make Telegram feel like a polished product concierge with progress cards, PDF gate packages, acknowledgement and fallback.

operator_channels.role: secondary/control-tower-capable operator path that needs a fluent journey definition
operator_channels.upgrade_needed: Define simple channel/thread semantics and remove noisy control-tower bureaucracy from normal product-owner use.

human_gate_experience_contract.fallback_policy: If PDF/video delivery fails, send a concise message plus public-safe artifact refs, retry rendering asynchronously, and do not treat the gate as delivered until a receipt exists.

pillar_coverage.name: Conversational Signal Intake
pillar_coverage.goal: Let a human describe product intent naturally without filling bureaucratic forms before the factory can start.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Needs manager prompt choreography, ambiguity handling and summary confirmation tuned for Telegram/Discord.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Users abandon intake or give low-quality signal because the first interaction feels like a form.

pillar_coverage.name: Manager as Single Conversational Bridge
pillar_coverage.goal: Keep the gerente as the human-facing concierge that starts the factory, projects Kanban state and routes only necessary questions.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Manager contract exists but needs stronger runtime UX duties and progress/gate packaging behavior.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Human is forced to talk to workers, poll boards or interpret internal factory noise.

pillar_coverage.name: Telegram Primary Operator Experience
pillar_coverage.goal: Make Telegram the first excellent operator path for product creation, status and human gates.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Telegram exists but needs richer progress cards, attachment delivery, fallback and acknowledgement loops.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: The current primary path remains useful but not delightful or confidently stateful.

pillar_coverage.name: Discord Target Operator Experience
pillar_coverage.goal: Define a fluent Discord operator path instead of blaming Discord for an undefined product experience.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Discord has control-tower structures but needs a simplified user journey and channel/thread mapping for non-bureaucratic use.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Discord remains noisy, confusing and underused despite platform capability.

pillar_coverage.name: Progress Visibility and Percent Complete
pillar_coverage.goal: Send meaningful progress updates with percent complete, done, doing, remaining, blockers and next gate context.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Status exists but the operator-facing progress projection must be elevated to product-grade UX.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: User loses trust because execution feels silent or opaque.

pillar_coverage.name: Autonomy Without Bureaucracy
pillar_coverage.goal: Keep the factory autonomous and independent; ask the human only for material decisions.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Needs strict gate trigger taxonomy and suppressed internal noise.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: The factory becomes a bureaucratic assistant that asks too much and reduces autonomy.

pillar_coverage.name: Human Gate Decision Package
pillar_coverage.goal: Deliver every real human gate as a readable decision package before asking for approval.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: The shape exists but needs PDF-first renderer, better layout standards and decision-option language.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Humans approve without understanding or reject because material is hard to read.

pillar_coverage.name: Beautiful PDF Delivery
pillar_coverage.goal: Make PDF the primary deep reading artifact for human gate decisions, with polished formatting and clear structure.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: PDF is required in contract but no dedicated quality bar/renderer proof exists yet.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Markdown/JSON dumps become the actual UX and degrade decision quality.

pillar_coverage.name: Video and Animation Explainers
pillar_coverage.goal: Use short video/animation when it helps explain architecture, flow, risk or decision tradeoffs.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Video explainer is optional but not operationalized as a factory capability.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Complex gates remain hard to understand for humans reviewing on mobile.

pillar_coverage.name: Plain-language PT-BR UX
pillar_coverage.goal: Keep user-facing messages and decision packages in simple PT-BR with concise wording and no internal jargon.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Language policy exists but needs copy-quality gate and examples.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Messages feel like internal machinery instead of a helpful product concierge.

pillar_coverage.name: Mobile-first Attachment UX
pillar_coverage.goal: Optimize gate packages and progress updates for mobile reading in Telegram/Discord.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Current contracts mention attachments but not mobile readability, hierarchy, file naming, size or preview behavior.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: PDF/video exists but is painful to consume on a phone.

pillar_coverage.name: Delivery Receipts and Acknowledgement
pillar_coverage.goal: Prove important notifications and gate packages were delivered, readable and acknowledged/decided.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Receipts exist but need UX-specific ack states and retry/fallback behavior.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Factory waits on a human who never saw or understood the gate package.

pillar_coverage.name: Decision Options and Scope Clarity
pillar_coverage.goal: Every human gate must present explicit options, consequences, approved scope and forbidden scope.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Decision records exist but need polished operator-facing option cards.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Human approval is ambiguous or authorizes more than intended.

pillar_coverage.name: Kanban Projection, Not Board Dump
pillar_coverage.goal: Translate Kanban execution into useful human status instead of dumping cards, JSON or raw board state.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Need projection rules that compress internal graph state into user context.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: The operator becomes a project manager for the factory instead of a product owner.

pillar_coverage.name: Failure and Blocker Experience
pillar_coverage.goal: When blocked, explain what happened, why it matters, what is safe next and whether human action is really required.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Needs blocker message templates and safe next-action cards.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Failures feel scary, vague or unnecessarily interruptive.

pillar_coverage.name: Cross-channel Consistency
pillar_coverage.goal: Telegram and Discord should expose the same product semantics even if the rendering differs by platform.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Need shared semantic layer for status cards, gate packages and receipts across channels.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: One channel becomes canonical by accident and the other drifts or stays unusable.

pillar_coverage.name: Manager Runtime Observability
pillar_coverage.goal: The manager must know when to notify based on real run/board state, not chat memory or vibes.
pillar_coverage.gap_or_upgrade: Need runtime-driven triggers tied to FactoryRun, DecisionOutbox and StatusSnapshot.
pillar_coverage.risk_if_missing: Notifications are late, duplicated, missing or ungrounded.

acceptance.runtime_claim: audit materialized only; runtime UX implementation remains partial and must be upgraded later
